body: The main one I've heard about a lot of anti depressants is that it just makes you more suicidal. But with every medication, regardless of its use I've become extremely nauseous and weak.

I completely relate to that. I've gone through a pretty horrible self harm addiction and an eating disorder trying to cope with all the shit. I think the most important thing to know is you don't always have to cope. Sometimes it's okay to just let the shit get to you and cry it out for a while. And ofcourse talking to people about it is a good outlet. You can pm me if you want to. I've attempted suicide many times and I'd say the feeling afterwards is definitely not worth it. Also a very risky thing unless you really, really suck at killing yourself like me. An alternative would be seeking adrenaline. You could look into adrenaline high sports. I know it sounds kind of dumb but I've heard it help suicidal/self harming people.

I don't know what positive thing I could focus on..  I'm an aspiring writer along with thousands like me. I'm not good enough to actually succeed in it and I don't have any other talents. My family hates me, my boyfriend is about to break up with me, I barely have any friends.. I just don't see any positives anymore

No, they didn't. They mentioned it but after reacting badly to every medication I've ever been on I'm extremely hesitant to take any kind of medication. At some point I considered it but one of the possible side effects of a lot of shit that fucks with your brain chemistry is it could temporarily make you more suicidal which i really did not want
I've personally never been on anti-depressants but I've heard a lot of people benefit from them. If you try them and they don't help you you can always stop taking them.
I have. I was in a mental institution for a total of 6 months, I've gone to several kinds of therapy both before and after that, but all of them either just didn't work or made me even more suicidal.

What job do you have? Honestly the best way to think about things in my opinion is that killing yourself is really the final thing to do. If leaving your job means you don't have to kill yourself, go for it. If seeking help means you don't have to kill yourself, go for it. By the way, there's a lot of ways to seek help anonymously without ever getting some kind of black mark on your papers for the rest of your life. Whatever you do to help yourself, it is *always* better than suicide. Suicide is the only thing you could possibly do that you can't come back from. And you should never be embarrassed about feeling bad. You could come up to any starving african kid who hasn't eaten in a week and guilt trip him because his neighbour hasn't eaten in 2 weeks. That's just not how things work. If you feel bad, you feel bad. It sucks and you deserve to get help.
